1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# heredoc-classifier.sh — library entry points for the FR-6 heredoc consumer
     3	# classifier (cycle-129 D-6.1). The single implementation lives in the fence,
     4	# .claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh; this file sources it in
     5	# library mode (BDB_LIB_ONLY=1, which the fence honours only when sourced) so
     6	# other scripts — guard-yield.sh's likely-false-positive heuristic — can call:
     7	#
     8	#   heredoc_consumer_class <command text>   prints interpreter|nonexec|none
     9	#   heredoc_nonexec <command text>          exit 0 iff the command's heredocs
    10	#                                           all have non-executing consumers
    11	#
    12	# Source only; never execute. Bash 3.2 compatible. When the fence cannot be
    13	# read the functions report "none" / exit 1, which callers treat as "no
    14	# classifier" (guard-yield.sh falls back to `<<` presence).
    15	_hc_lib_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    16	_hc_fence="${_hc_lib_dir}/../../hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
    17	if [[ -r "$_hc_fence" ]]; then
    18	  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    19	  BDB_LIB_ONLY=1 source "$_hc_fence"
    20	fi
    21	unset _hc_lib_dir _hc_fence
    22	
    23	heredoc_consumer_class() {
    24	  if declare -F _bdb_heredoc_consumer_class >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    25	    _bdb_heredoc_consumer_class "${1:-}"
    26	  else
    27	    printf 'none\n'
    28	  fi
    29	}
    30	
    31	heredoc_nonexec() {
    32	  [[ "$(heredoc_consumer_class "${1:-}")" == nonexec ]]
    33	}
diff --git a/base/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh b/head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh
index f9aa8c4..2868465 100644
--- a/base/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh
+++ b/head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh
@@ -120,6 +120,649 @@
 # is exec'd only inside emit_block and the FR-SZ bypass audit branch).
 # =============================================================================
 
+# =============================================================================
+# FR-6 heredoc consumer classifier (cycle-129 D-6.1; knob
+# destructive_command_guard.heredoc_classifier, default true; false = the
+# pre-cycle scan, i.e. only the #1245 quoted-cat scrub below).
+# Defined BEFORE the bash-version guard and the stdin read so another script
+# can source this file with BDB_LIB_ONLY=1 and call
+#   _bdb_heredoc_consumer_class <command text>   → prints interpreter|nonexec|none
+#   heredoc_nonexec <command text>               → exit 0 iff nonexec
+# Bash 3.2 compatible (no ${x,,}, no mapfile, no associative arrays) and safe
+# under a caller's `set -u`.
+#
+# Grammar (literal command text; no alias or function expansion; CRLF folded
+# to LF). The command is walked line by line; a line holding an unquoted
+# `<<` / `<<-` (not `<<<`) is a heredoc header, the body runs to the first
+# line equal to the delimiter (leading tabs stripped for `<<-`). FULL SCAN
+# (the whole command as today) on: any other control character, a header the
+# tokenizer cannot read (open quote, trailing backslash, comment), more than
+# one heredoc on a header, a delimiter that is not a plain word ('W', "W",
+# \W or W with W in [A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]; `$X` is a variable delimiter), or a
+# missing terminator. Per heredoc the class is:
+#   interpreter — body scanned exactly as today: the header holds `$(`, a
+#     backtick, `<(` or `>(`, a paren or brace group or a shell keyword; it
+#     continues on the next line (`|`, `&&`, `||` last) or an earlier line
+#     opened a substitution, group, quote or pipe; a member of the heredoc's
+#     pipeline is a shell, interpreter, wrapper that runs its argument or SQL
+#     runner (_bdb_hd_is_interp, _bdb_hd_is_runner); an allowlisted form
+#     carries an unknown or exec-shaped flag (-c, -e, -x clusters, --exec,
+#     --eval, --command, in-place); a write target is executable content
+#     (_bdb_hd_exec_dest: script extension, .claude/hooks, .claude/settings*
+#     .json, .git/hooks, .git/config, rc/profile files, /etc, a bin dir or a
+#     directory on PATH, or any non-literal path); the first body line is a
+#     shebang; the body holds `<<` (nested); a target's basename appears
+#     elsewhere in the command outside the safe readers (_bdb_hd_same_line_exec:
+#     `bash x`, `./x`, `source x`, `. x`, `chmod +x x`, `exec x`, cp/mv …).
+#   nonexec — every pipeline member is an exact allowlisted form
+#     (_bdb_hd_member): cat, tee, printf, echo with plain-file or stdout sinks;
+#     gh pr|issue comment -F -; gh pr create --body-file -; git commit -F -;
+#     br create|update reading `-`; jq/yq without in-place; grep; sed -n with
+#     a print-only script; sort; wc. The body is then scanned PER SEGMENT
+#     (_bdb_hd_scan_body): each line split on ; && || | &, wrapper prefixes
+#     stripped (sudo command exec env nice time nohup builtin stdbuf ionice,
+#     a leading backslash, quote, paren or brace, assignments, an absolute
+#     path); a segment whose command word is a fence verb (rm git find dd
+#     mkfs* shred truncate kubectl terraform aws gcloud psql mysql DROP
+#     DELETE TRUNCATE) is kept on its own line for the normal rules, other
+#     segments are dropped. The body falls back to a full scan when it holds
+#     `$(`, a backtick, `<(` or `>(` under an unquoted delimiter, or a segment
+#     word is an interpreter or wrapper, or a variable (`$x -rf /`; such a
+#     segment is ALSO scanned as rm, git and kubectl with the same arguments).
+#     Special case (the #1245 scrub): a standalone quoted-delimiter `cat`
+#     whose header is exactly `cat <<'W' [> path]` drops the whole body.
+#   none — the consumer is on neither list: full scan.
+# Documented gap: a body written to a plain file by one command and executed
+# by a LATER command is outside a per-command fence (the Write tool shares it).
+# =============================================================================
+_bdb_hd_op_re='^[0-9]*(<<<|<<-|&>>|<<|>>|>[|]|&&|[|][|]|[|]&|&>|<>|>&[0-9-]*|<&[0-9-]*|;;|;|&|[|]|<|>|[(]|[)])$'
+_bdb_hd_re_dw='^[A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+$'
+_bdb_hd_re_dsq="^'([A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+)'\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_ddq='^"([A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+)"$'
+_bdb_hd_re_dbs='^\\([A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+)$'
+_bdb_hd_re_psq="^'([^']*)'\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_pdq="^\"([^\"\$\`\\\\]*)\"\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_pbare="^[^'\"\$\`\\\\]+\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_ctl=$'[\x01-\x08\x0b-\x1f\x7f]'
+_bdb_hd_re_exflag='^-[A-Za-z]*[cex][A-Za-z]*$'
+_bdb_hd_re_exlong='^--(exec|eval|command|in-?place)'
+_bdb_hd_re_ext='\.(sh|bash|zsh|ksh|csh|fish|py|pyw|rb|pl|pm|js|mjs|cjs|ts|mts|cts|ps1|psm1|php|lua|tcl|command|bat|cmd)$'
+_bdb_hd_re_sys='(^|/)(\.claude/hooks(/|$)|\.claude/settings[^/]*\.json$|\.git/hooks(/|$)|\.git/config$|\.gitconfig$|\.ssh/rc$|\.config/(fish|zsh|bash|git)/|s?bin/[^/]+$)'
+_bdb_hd_re_rc='(^|/)\.(bashrc|bash_profile|bash_login|bash_logout|profile|zshrc|zshenv|zprofile|zlogin|zlogout|kshrc|mkshrc|cshrc|tcshrc|login|logout|envrc)$'
+_bdb_hd_re_sedp='^(([0-9]+|[$]|/[^/]*/)(,([0-9]+|[$]|/[^/]*/))?)?p$'
+_bdb_hd_re_assign='^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*='
+_bdb_hd_re_varw='^[$]([{]|[A-Za-z_])'
+_bdb_hd_re_knob='^[[:space:]]+heredoc_classifier:[[:space:]]*["'"'"']?([A-Za-z]+)["'"'"']?[[:space:]]*(#.*)?$'
+
+# Shells, interpreters and wrappers that run their argument or stdin.
+_bdb_hd_is_interp() {
+  case "$1" in
+    bash|sh|zsh|dash|ksh|mksh|ash|fish|csh|tcsh|busybox|python|python[0-9]*|pypy*|node|nodejs|deno|bun|ruby|irb|perl|php|lua|luajit|tclsh|wish|expect|pwsh|powershell|osascript|Rscript) return 0 ;;
+    eval|source|.|exec|command|builtin|time|awk|gawk|mawk|nawk|make|gmake|m4|ed|ex|vi|vim|nvim|gdb) return 0 ;;
+    sudo|doas|su|runuser|env|xargs|parallel|timeout|nohup|nice|ionice|setsid|stdbuf|chroot|unshare|nsenter|ssh|docker|podman|kubectl|find|watch|script) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+# The SQL runners of the FR-1.4/5/6 precondition (same list).
+_bdb_hd_is_runner() {
+  case "$1" in
+    psql|pgcli|mysql|mariadb|mysqlsh|sqlite3|sqlcmd|sqlplus|isql|usql|litecli|duckdb|clickhouse|clickhouse-client|cockroach|bq|wrangler|prisma|supabase|drizzle-kit|knex|sequelize|typeorm|flyway|liquibase|dbmate|goose|sqitch|rails|manage.py|artisan|alembic|dbt|atlas|mongosh|sqlx) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+# Command words the fence's own rules match.
+_bdb_hd_is_destructive() {
+  case "$1" in
+    rm|git|find|dd|shred|truncate|kubectl|terraform|aws|gcloud|psql|mysql|mkfs|mkfs.*) return 0 ;;
+    [Dd][Rr][Oo][Pp]|[Dd][Ee][Ll][Ee][Tt][Ee]|[Tt][Rr][Uu][Nn][Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee]) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+# Readers that may name a heredoc's target elsewhere on the line.
+_bdb_hd_is_safe_reader() {
+  case "$1" in
+    cat|ls|wc|head|tail|grep|egrep|fgrep|rg|diff|cmp|stat|file|test|'['|echo|printf|sort|uniq|jq|yq|git|gh|br|mkdir|touch|realpath|readlink|basename|dirname|du|md5sum|sha1sum|sha256sum|shasum|b2sum|cksum) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_tokenize <line> → _bdb_hd_tok[] (words keep their quotes; operators
+# are separate tokens, an fd number joins its redirect). Returns 1 when the
+# line cannot be read: open quote, trailing backslash, unquoted comment.
+_bdb_hd_tokenize() {
+  local s="${1:-}" n i=0 ch tok="" q="" have=0 op cand
+  n=${#s}
+  _bdb_hd_tok=()
+  while (( i < n )); do
+    ch="${s:i:1}"
+    if [[ -n "$q" ]]; then
+      tok="$tok$ch"
+      if [[ "$q" == "'" ]]; then
+        [[ "$ch" == "'" ]] && q=""
+      elif [[ "$ch" == '\' ]]; then
+        (( i + 1 < n )) || return 1
+        i=$((i + 1)); tok="$tok${s:i:1}"
+      elif [[ "$ch" == '"' ]]; then
+        q=""
+      fi
+      i=$((i + 1)); continue
+    fi
+    case "$ch" in
+      "'"|'"') q="$ch"; tok="$tok$ch"; have=1; i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+      '\')
+        (( i + 1 < n )) || return 1
+        tok="$tok$ch${s:i+1:1}"; have=1; i=$((i + 2)) ;;
+      ' '|$'\t')
+        if (( have )); then _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$tok"; tok=""; have=0; fi
+        i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+      '#')
+        (( have )) || return 1
+        tok="$tok$ch"; i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+      ';'|'&'|'|'|'<'|'>'|'('|')')
+        op=""
+        for cand in '<<<' '<<-' '&>>' '<<' '>>' '>|' '&&' '||' '|&' '&>' '<>' '>&' '<&' ';;' ';' '&' '|' '<' '>' '(' ')'; do
+          if [[ "${s:i:${#cand}}" == "$cand" ]]; then op="$cand"; break; fi
+        done
+        i=$((i + ${#op}))
+        if [[ "$op" == '>&' || "$op" == '<&' ]]; then
+          while (( i < n )) && [[ "${s:i:1}" == [0-9-] ]]; do op="$op${s:i:1}"; i=$((i + 1)); done
+        fi
+        if (( have )); then
+          if [[ "$tok" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [[ "$op" == '<'* || "$op" == '>'* ]]; then
+            op="$tok$op"
+          else
+            _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$tok"
+          fi
+          tok=""; have=0
+        fi
+        _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$op" ;;
+      *) tok="$tok$ch"; have=1; i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+    esac
+  done
+  [[ -z "$q" ]] || return 1
+  (( have )) && _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$tok"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_unq_path <word> → _hd_up; returns 1 for a non-literal path (an
+# expansion, an escape, mixed quoting) or an empty one.
+_bdb_hd_unq_path() {
+  _hd_up=""
+  if [[ "${1:-}" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_psq ]] || [[ "${1:-}" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_pdq ]]; then
+    _hd_up="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
+  elif [[ "${1:-}" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_pbare ]]; then
+    _hd_up="$1"
+  else
+    return 1
+  fi
+  [[ -n "$_hd_up" ]]
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_exec_dest <unquoted path> → 0 when a write there is executable
+# content (or cannot be judged).
+_bdb_hd_exec_dest() {
+  local p="${1:-}" d e b old_ifs
+  case "$p" in
+    *'*'*|*'?'*|*'['*|*'{'*|'~'|'~'[!/]*|'') return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  [[ "$p" == '~/'* ]] && p="${HOME:-}/${p#'~/'}"
+  b="${p##*/}"
+  [[ "$b" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_ext ]] && return 0
+  [[ "$p" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_sys || "$p" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_rc ]] && return 0
+  [[ "$p" == /etc/* ]] && return 0
+  if [[ "$p" == /* ]]; then d="${p%/*}"; [[ -n "$d" ]] || d="/"
+  elif [[ "$p" == */* ]]; then d="${PWD:-.}/${p%/*}"
+  else d="${PWD:-.}"
+  fi
+  old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS=':'
+  for e in ${PATH:-}; do
+    [[ -z "$e" || "$e" == "." ]] && e="${PWD:-.}"
+    [[ "$e" != "/" ]] && e="${e%/}"
+    if [[ "$d" == "$e" ]]; then IFS="$old_ifs"; return 0; fi
+  done
+  IFS="$old_ifs"
+  return 1
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_member <tokens…> → _hd_mcls (interpreter|nonexec|none) for one
+# pipeline member; write targets are appended to _hd_dests.
+_bdb_hd_member() {
+  local -a toks argv
+  local t nxt i n stdout_files=0 a0 base fd stdin=0 ops=0 want="" has_n=0 script=""
+  toks=("$@"); n=${#toks[@]}; argv=()
+  _hd_mcls=none
+  for ((i = 0; i < n; i++)); do
+    t="${toks[i]}"
+    if [[ "$t" =~ $_bdb_hd_op_re ]]; then
+      case "$t" in
+        *'<<<') return ;;
+        *'<<'|*'<<-') i=$((i + 1)); continue ;;
+        *'>&'[0-9]*|*'>&-'|*'<&'*) continue ;;
+        *'>'|*'>>'|*'>|'|*'>&'|'&>'|'&>>')
+          nxt="${toks[i+1]:-}"; i=$((i + 1))
+          if [[ -z "$nxt" || "$nxt" =~ $_bdb_hd_op_re ]]; then _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; fi
+          _bdb_hd_unq_path "$nxt" || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }
+          case "$_hd_up" in /dev/null|/dev/stdout|/dev/stderr) continue ;; esac
+          _hd_dests[${#_hd_dests[@]}]="$_hd_up"
+          fd="${t%%[>&]*}"
+          [[ -z "$fd" || "$fd" == 1 || "$t" == '&>'* || "$t" == '>&' ]] && stdout_files=$((stdout_files + 1))
+          continue ;;
+        *) return ;;
+      esac
+    fi
+    argv[${#argv[@]}]="$t"
+  done
+  (( ${#argv[@]} > 0 )) || return
+  a0="${argv[0]}"
+  base="${a0#\\}"; base="${base##*/}"
+  if _bdb_hd_is_interp "$base" || _bdb_hd_is_runner "$base"; then _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; fi
+  [[ "$a0" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$ ]] || return
+  (( stdout_files <= 1 )) || return
+  for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+    t="${argv[i]}"
+    if [[ "$t" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_exflag || "$t" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_exlong ]]; then _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; fi
+  done
+  case "$a0" in
+    cat)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do [[ "${argv[i]}" == "-" ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }; done ;;
+    tee)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -a|--append|-p) ;;
+          -*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+          *) _bdb_hd_unq_path "$t" || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }
+             _hd_dests[${#_hd_dests[@]}]="$_hd_up" ;;
+        esac
+      done ;;
+    echo|printf)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        case "${argv[i]}" in -n|-E) ;; -*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;; esac
+      done ;;
+    gh)
+      case "${argv[1]:-} ${argv[2]:-}" in
+        "pr comment"|"issue comment") want=" -F --body-file -R --repo |" ;;
+        "pr create") want=" -F --body-file --title -t --base -B --head -H --repo -R --label -l --reviewer -r --assignee -a --milestone -m --project -p --template -T | --draft -d --fill --fill-first --fill-verbose --no-maintainer-edit --dry-run " ;;
+        *) return ;;
+      esac
+      for ((i = 3; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          --body-file=-) stdin=1 ;;
+          --*=*) [[ "${want%%|*}" == *" ${t%%=*} "* ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+          -*)
+            if [[ "${want%%|*}" == *" $t "* ]]; then
+              i=$((i + 1))
+              [[ ( "$t" == "-F" || "$t" == "--body-file" ) && "${argv[i]:-}" == "-" ]] && stdin=1
+            elif [[ "${want#*|}" != *" $t "* ]]; then
+              _hd_mcls=interpreter; return
+            fi ;;
+          *) ops=$((ops + 1)); [[ "${argv[2]}" == comment && $ops -le 1 ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( stdin )) || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    git)
+      [[ "${argv[1]:-}" == commit ]] || return
+      for ((i = 2; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -F|--file) i=$((i + 1)); [[ "${argv[i]:-}" == "-" ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }; stdin=1 ;;
+          --file=-|-F-) stdin=1 ;;
+          -q|--quiet|-s|--signoff|-a|--all|--allow-empty|--allow-empty-message|-v|--verbose|--no-edit|--amend) ;;
+          *) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( stdin )) || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    br)
+      case "${argv[1]:-}" in create|update) ;; *) return ;; esac
+      for ((i = 2; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -d|--description|--body) [[ "${argv[i+1]:-}" == "-" ]] && stdin=1 ;;
+          -f|--file) [[ "${argv[1]}" == create && "${argv[i+1]:-}" == "-" ]] && stdin=1 ;;
+          --description=-|--body=-) stdin=1 ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( stdin )) || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    jq|yq)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        # In-place flags: --inplace/--in-place, -i, -i=…, and any short-flag cluster holding an i
+        # (corpus D114/D115: `-i` alone did not match `-[A-Za-z]*i*`, which needs a letter before the i).
+        case "${argv[i]}" in --inplace|--in-place|-i*|-[A-Za-z]*i*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;; esac
+      done ;;
+    grep|egrep|fgrep) ;;
+    sed)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -n|--quiet|--silent) has_n=1 ;;
+          -E|-r|--regexp-extended|-s|--separate|-u|--unbuffered|-z|--null-data) ;;
+          -*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+          *) if [[ -z "$script" ]]; then
+               script="$t"; [[ "$script" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_psq || "$script" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_pdq ]] && script="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
+               [[ "$script" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_sedp ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }
+             fi ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( has_n )) && [[ -n "$script" ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    sort)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -o) i=$((i + 1)); _bdb_hd_unq_path "${argv[i]:-}" || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }; _hd_dests[${#_hd_dests[@]}]="$_hd_up" ;;
+          -k|-t) i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+          -k*|-t*) ;;
+          --*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+          -*) [[ "$t" =~ ^-[bdfghiMnRrsuVz]+$ ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+        esac
+      done ;;
+    wc)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        case "${argv[i]}" in -*) [[ "${argv[i]}" =~ ^-[lwmL]+$ ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;; esac
+      done ;;
+    *) return ;;
+  esac
+  _hd_mcls=nonexec
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_ctx_bad <line> → 0 when a line before (or the header itself) leaves
+# the next text inside a substitution, group, quote, compound command or
+# pipeline: a later heredoc there is interpreter-class.
+_bdb_hd_ctx_bad() {
+  local l="${1:-}" k last
+  case "$l" in *'$('*|*'`'*|*'<('*|*'>('*) return 0 ;; esac
+  _bdb_hd_tokenize "$l" || return 0
+  for ((k = 0; k < ${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}; k++)); do
+    case "${_bdb_hd_tok[k]}" in
+      '('|')'|'{'|'}'|do|done|then|else|elif|if|fi|while|until|for|case|esac|select|function|coproc) return 0 ;;
+    esac
+  done
+  (( ${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]} > 0 )) || return 1
+  last="${_bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}-1]}"
+  case "$last" in '|'|'|&'|'&&'|'||') return 0 ;; esac
+  return 1
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_header <line> — parse one header line. Sets _hd_ops (heredoc count,
+# -1 = unreadable), _hd_delim, _hd_quoted, _hd_tabs, _hd_cls, _hd_dests[],
+# _hd_pipe (pipeline id of the heredoc on this line).
+_bdb_hd_header() {
+  local line="${1:-}" k nt t opi=-1 w seg=0 pipe=0
+  local -a tpipe mtoks
+  _hd_ops=0 _hd_delim="" _hd_quoted=0 _hd_tabs=0 _hd_cls=none _hd_pipe=-1
+  _hd_dests=()
+  if ! _bdb_hd_tokenize "$line"; then _hd_ops=-1; return; fi
+  nt=${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}
+  tpipe=()
+  for ((k = 0; k < nt; k++)); do
+    t="${_bdb_hd_tok[k]}"
+    case "$t" in
+      ';'|';;'|'&'|'&&'|'||'|'('|')') pipe=$((pipe + 1)); tpipe[k]=-1; continue ;;
+      '|'|'|&') tpipe[k]=-1; continue ;;
+    esac
+    tpipe[k]=$pipe
+    if [[ "$t" =~ ^[0-9]*'<<'-?$ ]]; then _hd_ops=$((_hd_ops + 1)); opi=$k; fi
+  done
+  (( _hd_ops == 1 )) || return
+  w="${_bdb_hd_tok[opi+1]:-}"
+  [[ "${_bdb_hd_tok[opi]}" == *'<<-' ]] && _hd_tabs=1
+  if [[ "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_dsq || "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_ddq || "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_dbs ]]; then
+    _hd_delim="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; _hd_quoted=1
+  elif [[ "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_dw ]]; then
+    _hd_delim="$w"
+  else
+    _hd_ops=-1; return        # variable-expanded, mixed or missing delimiter

+# =============================================================================
+# FR-6 heredoc consumer classifier (cycle-129 D-6.1; knob
+# destructive_command_guard.heredoc_classifier, default true; false = the
+# pre-cycle scan, i.e. only the #1245 quoted-cat scrub below).
+# Defined BEFORE the bash-version guard and the stdin read so another script
+# can source this file with BDB_LIB_ONLY=1 and call
+#   _bdb_heredoc_consumer_class <command text>   → prints interpreter|nonexec|none
+#   heredoc_nonexec <command text>               → exit 0 iff nonexec
+# Bash 3.2 compatible (no ${x,,}, no mapfile, no associative arrays) and safe
+# under a caller's `set -u`.
+#
+# Grammar (literal command text; no alias or function expansion; CRLF folded
+# to LF). The command is walked line by line; a line holding an unquoted
+# `<<` / `<<-` (not `<<<`) is a heredoc header, the body runs to the first
+# line equal to the delimiter (leading tabs stripped for `<<-`). FULL SCAN
+# (the whole command as today) on: any other control character, a header the
+# tokenizer cannot read (open quote, trailing backslash, comment), more than
+# one heredoc on a header, a delimiter that is not a plain word ('W', "W",
+# \W or W with W in [A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]; `$X` is a variable delimiter), or a
+# missing terminator. Per heredoc the class is:
+#   interpreter — body scanned exactly as today: the header holds `$(`, a
+#     backtick, `<(` or `>(`, a paren or brace group or a shell keyword; it
+#     continues on the next line (`|`, `&&`, `||` last) or an earlier line
+#     opened a substitution, group, quote or pipe; a member of the heredoc's
+#     pipeline is a shell, interpreter, wrapper that runs its argument or SQL
+#     runner (_bdb_hd_is_interp, _bdb_hd_is_runner); an allowlisted form
+#     carries an unknown or exec-shaped flag (-c, -e, -x clusters, --exec,
+#     --eval, --command, in-place); a write target is executable content
+#     (_bdb_hd_exec_dest: script extension, .claude/hooks, .claude/settings*
+#     .json, .git/hooks, .git/config, rc/profile files, /etc, a bin dir or a
+#     directory on PATH, or any non-literal path); the first body line is a
+#     shebang; the body holds `<<` (nested); a target's basename appears
+#     elsewhere in the command outside the safe readers (_bdb_hd_same_line_exec:
+#     `bash x`, `./x`, `source x`, `. x`, `chmod +x x`, `exec x`, cp/mv …).
+#   nonexec — every pipeline member is an exact allowlisted form
+#     (_bdb_hd_member): cat, tee, printf, echo with plain-file or stdout sinks;
+#     gh pr|issue comment -F -; gh pr create --body-file -; git commit -F -;
+#     br create|update reading `-`; jq/yq without in-place; grep; sed -n with
+#     a print-only script; sort; wc. The body is then scanned PER SEGMENT
+#     (_bdb_hd_scan_body): each line split on ; && || | &, wrapper prefixes
+#     stripped (sudo command exec env nice time nohup builtin stdbuf ionice,
+#     a leading backslash, quote, paren or brace, assignments, an absolute
+#     path); a segment whose command word is a fence verb (rm git find dd
+#     mkfs* shred truncate kubectl terraform aws gcloud psql mysql DROP
+#     DELETE TRUNCATE) is kept on its own line for the normal rules, other
+#     segments are dropped. The body falls back to a full scan when it holds
+#     `$(`, a backtick, `<(` or `>(` under an unquoted delimiter, or a segment
+#     word is an interpreter or wrapper, or a variable (`$x -rf /`; such a
+#     segment is ALSO scanned as rm, git and kubectl with the same arguments).
+#     Special case (the #1245 scrub): a standalone quoted-delimiter `cat`
+#     whose header is exactly `cat <<'W' [> path]` drops the whole body.
+#   none — the consumer is on neither list: full scan.
+# Documented gap: a body written to a plain file by one command and executed
+# by a LATER command is outside a per-command fence (the Write tool shares it).
+# =============================================================================
+_bdb_hd_op_re='^[0-9]*(<<<|<<-|&>>|<<|>>|>[|]|&&|[|][|]|[|]&|&>|<>|>&[0-9-]*|<&[0-9-]*|;;|;|&|[|]|<|>|[(]|[)])$'
+_bdb_hd_re_dw='^[A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+$'
+_bdb_hd_re_dsq="^'([A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+)'\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_ddq='^"([A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+)"$'
+_bdb_hd_re_dbs='^\\([A-Za-z0-9_.+:@%-]+)$'
+_bdb_hd_re_psq="^'([^']*)'\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_pdq="^\"([^\"\$\`\\\\]*)\"\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_pbare="^[^'\"\$\`\\\\]+\$"
+_bdb_hd_re_ctl=$'[\x01-\x08\x0b-\x1f\x7f]'
+_bdb_hd_re_exflag='^-[A-Za-z]*[cex][A-Za-z]*$'
+_bdb_hd_re_exlong='^--(exec|eval|command|in-?place)'
+_bdb_hd_re_ext='\.(sh|bash|zsh|ksh|csh|fish|py|pyw|rb|pl|pm|js|mjs|cjs|ts|mts|cts|ps1|psm1|php|lua|tcl|command|bat|cmd)$'
+_bdb_hd_re_sys='(^|/)(\.claude/hooks(/|$)|\.claude/settings[^/]*\.json$|\.git/hooks(/|$)|\.git/config$|\.gitconfig$|\.ssh/rc$|\.config/(fish|zsh|bash|git)/|s?bin/[^/]+$)'
+_bdb_hd_re_rc='(^|/)\.(bashrc|bash_profile|bash_login|bash_logout|profile|zshrc|zshenv|zprofile|zlogin|zlogout|kshrc|mkshrc|cshrc|tcshrc|login|logout|envrc)$'
+_bdb_hd_re_sedp='^(([0-9]+|[$]|/[^/]*/)(,([0-9]+|[$]|/[^/]*/))?)?p$'
+_bdb_hd_re_assign='^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*='
+_bdb_hd_re_varw='^[$]([{]|[A-Za-z_])'
+_bdb_hd_re_knob='^[[:space:]]+heredoc_classifier:[[:space:]]*["'"'"']?([A-Za-z]+)["'"'"']?[[:space:]]*(#.*)?$'
+
+# Shells, interpreters and wrappers that run their argument or stdin.
+_bdb_hd_is_interp() {
+  case "$1" in
+    bash|sh|zsh|dash|ksh|mksh|ash|fish|csh|tcsh|busybox|python|python[0-9]*|pypy*|node|nodejs|deno|bun|ruby|irb|perl|php|lua|luajit|tclsh|wish|expect|pwsh|powershell|osascript|Rscript) return 0 ;;
+    eval|source|.|exec|command|builtin|time|awk|gawk|mawk|nawk|make|gmake|m4|ed|ex|vi|vim|nvim|gdb) return 0 ;;
+    sudo|doas|su|runuser|env|xargs|parallel|timeout|nohup|nice|ionice|setsid|stdbuf|chroot|unshare|nsenter|ssh|docker|podman|kubectl|find|watch|script) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+# The SQL runners of the FR-1.4/5/6 precondition (same list).
+_bdb_hd_is_runner() {
+  case "$1" in
+    psql|pgcli|mysql|mariadb|mysqlsh|sqlite3|sqlcmd|sqlplus|isql|usql|litecli|duckdb|clickhouse|clickhouse-client|cockroach|bq|wrangler|prisma|supabase|drizzle-kit|knex|sequelize|typeorm|flyway|liquibase|dbmate|goose|sqitch|rails|manage.py|artisan|alembic|dbt|atlas|mongosh|sqlx) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+# Command words the fence's own rules match.
+_bdb_hd_is_destructive() {
+  case "$1" in
+    rm|git|find|dd|shred|truncate|kubectl|terraform|aws|gcloud|psql|mysql|mkfs|mkfs.*) return 0 ;;
+    [Dd][Rr][Oo][Pp]|[Dd][Ee][Ll][Ee][Tt][Ee]|[Tt][Rr][Uu][Nn][Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee]) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+# Readers that may name a heredoc's target elsewhere on the line.
+_bdb_hd_is_safe_reader() {
+  case "$1" in
+    cat|ls|wc|head|tail|grep|egrep|fgrep|rg|diff|cmp|stat|file|test|'['|echo|printf|sort|uniq|jq|yq|git|gh|br|mkdir|touch|realpath|readlink|basename|dirname|du|md5sum|sha1sum|sha256sum|shasum|b2sum|cksum) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_tokenize <line> → _bdb_hd_tok[] (words keep their quotes; operators
+# are separate tokens, an fd number joins its redirect). Returns 1 when the
+# line cannot be read: open quote, trailing backslash, unquoted comment.
+_bdb_hd_tokenize() {
+  local s="${1:-}" n i=0 ch tok="" q="" have=0 op cand
+  n=${#s}
+  _bdb_hd_tok=()
+  while (( i < n )); do
+    ch="${s:i:1}"
+    if [[ -n "$q" ]]; then
+      tok="$tok$ch"
+      if [[ "$q" == "'" ]]; then
+        [[ "$ch" == "'" ]] && q=""
+      elif [[ "$ch" == '\' ]]; then
+        (( i + 1 < n )) || return 1
+        i=$((i + 1)); tok="$tok${s:i:1}"
+      elif [[ "$ch" == '"' ]]; then
+        q=""
+      fi
+      i=$((i + 1)); continue
+    fi
+    case "$ch" in
+      "'"|'"') q="$ch"; tok="$tok$ch"; have=1; i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+      '\')
+        (( i + 1 < n )) || return 1
+        tok="$tok$ch${s:i+1:1}"; have=1; i=$((i + 2)) ;;
+      ' '|$'\t')
+        if (( have )); then _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$tok"; tok=""; have=0; fi
+        i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+      '#')
+        (( have )) || return 1
+        tok="$tok$ch"; i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+      ';'|'&'|'|'|'<'|'>'|'('|')')
+        op=""
+        for cand in '<<<' '<<-' '&>>' '<<' '>>' '>|' '&&' '||' '|&' '&>' '<>' '>&' '<&' ';;' ';' '&' '|' '<' '>' '(' ')'; do
+          if [[ "${s:i:${#cand}}" == "$cand" ]]; then op="$cand"; break; fi
+        done
+        i=$((i + ${#op}))
+        if [[ "$op" == '>&' || "$op" == '<&' ]]; then
+          while (( i < n )) && [[ "${s:i:1}" == [0-9-] ]]; do op="$op${s:i:1}"; i=$((i + 1)); done
+        fi
+        if (( have )); then
+          if [[ "$tok" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [[ "$op" == '<'* || "$op" == '>'* ]]; then
+            op="$tok$op"
+          else
+            _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$tok"
+          fi
+          tok=""; have=0
+        fi
+        _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$op" ;;
+      *) tok="$tok$ch"; have=1; i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+    esac
+  done
+  [[ -z "$q" ]] || return 1
+  (( have )) && _bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}]="$tok"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_unq_path <word> → _hd_up; returns 1 for a non-literal path (an
+# expansion, an escape, mixed quoting) or an empty one.
+_bdb_hd_unq_path() {
+  _hd_up=""
+  if [[ "${1:-}" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_psq ]] || [[ "${1:-}" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_pdq ]]; then
+    _hd_up="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
+  elif [[ "${1:-}" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_pbare ]]; then
+    _hd_up="$1"
+  else
+    return 1
+  fi
+  [[ -n "$_hd_up" ]]
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_exec_dest <unquoted path> → 0 when a write there is executable
+# content (or cannot be judged).
+_bdb_hd_exec_dest() {
+  local p="${1:-}" d e b old_ifs
+  case "$p" in
+    *'*'*|*'?'*|*'['*|*'{'*|'~'|'~'[!/]*|'') return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  [[ "$p" == '~/'* ]] && p="${HOME:-}/${p#'~/'}"
+  b="${p##*/}"
+  [[ "$b" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_ext ]] && return 0
+  [[ "$p" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_sys || "$p" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_rc ]] && return 0
+  [[ "$p" == /etc/* ]] && return 0
+  if [[ "$p" == /* ]]; then d="${p%/*}"; [[ -n "$d" ]] || d="/"
+  elif [[ "$p" == */* ]]; then d="${PWD:-.}/${p%/*}"
+  else d="${PWD:-.}"
+  fi
+  old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS=':'
+  for e in ${PATH:-}; do
+    [[ -z "$e" || "$e" == "." ]] && e="${PWD:-.}"
+    [[ "$e" != "/" ]] && e="${e%/}"
+    if [[ "$d" == "$e" ]]; then IFS="$old_ifs"; return 0; fi
+  done
+  IFS="$old_ifs"
+  return 1
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_member <tokens…> → _hd_mcls (interpreter|nonexec|none) for one
+# pipeline member; write targets are appended to _hd_dests.
+_bdb_hd_member() {
+  local -a toks argv
+  local t nxt i n stdout_files=0 a0 base fd stdin=0 ops=0 want="" has_n=0 script=""
+  toks=("$@"); n=${#toks[@]}; argv=()
+  _hd_mcls=none
+  for ((i = 0; i < n; i++)); do
+    t="${toks[i]}"
+    if [[ "$t" =~ $_bdb_hd_op_re ]]; then
+      case "$t" in
+        *'<<<') return ;;
+        *'<<'|*'<<-') i=$((i + 1)); continue ;;
+        *'>&'[0-9]*|*'>&-'|*'<&'*) continue ;;
+        *'>'|*'>>'|*'>|'|*'>&'|'&>'|'&>>')
+          nxt="${toks[i+1]:-}"; i=$((i + 1))
+          if [[ -z "$nxt" || "$nxt" =~ $_bdb_hd_op_re ]]; then _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; fi
+          _bdb_hd_unq_path "$nxt" || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }
+          case "$_hd_up" in /dev/null|/dev/stdout|/dev/stderr) continue ;; esac
+          _hd_dests[${#_hd_dests[@]}]="$_hd_up"
+          fd="${t%%[>&]*}"
+          [[ -z "$fd" || "$fd" == 1 || "$t" == '&>'* || "$t" == '>&' ]] && stdout_files=$((stdout_files + 1))
+          continue ;;
+        *) return ;;
+      esac
+    fi
+    argv[${#argv[@]}]="$t"
+  done
+  (( ${#argv[@]} > 0 )) || return
+  a0="${argv[0]}"
+  base="${a0#\\}"; base="${base##*/}"
+  if _bdb_hd_is_interp "$base" || _bdb_hd_is_runner "$base"; then _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; fi
+  [[ "$a0" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$ ]] || return
+  (( stdout_files <= 1 )) || return
+  for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+    t="${argv[i]}"
+    if [[ "$t" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_exflag || "$t" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_exlong ]]; then _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; fi
+  done
+  case "$a0" in
+    cat)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do [[ "${argv[i]}" == "-" ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }; done ;;
+    tee)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -a|--append|-p) ;;
+          -*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+          *) _bdb_hd_unq_path "$t" || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }
+             _hd_dests[${#_hd_dests[@]}]="$_hd_up" ;;
+        esac
+      done ;;
+    echo|printf)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        case "${argv[i]}" in -n|-E) ;; -*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;; esac
+      done ;;
+    gh)
+      case "${argv[1]:-} ${argv[2]:-}" in
+        "pr comment"|"issue comment") want=" -F --body-file -R --repo |" ;;
+        "pr create") want=" -F --body-file --title -t --base -B --head -H --repo -R --label -l --reviewer -r --assignee -a --milestone -m --project -p --template -T | --draft -d --fill --fill-first --fill-verbose --no-maintainer-edit --dry-run " ;;
+        *) return ;;
+      esac
+      for ((i = 3; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          --body-file=-) stdin=1 ;;
+          --*=*) [[ "${want%%|*}" == *" ${t%%=*} "* ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+          -*)
+            if [[ "${want%%|*}" == *" $t "* ]]; then
+              i=$((i + 1))
+              [[ ( "$t" == "-F" || "$t" == "--body-file" ) && "${argv[i]:-}" == "-" ]] && stdin=1
+            elif [[ "${want#*|}" != *" $t "* ]]; then
+              _hd_mcls=interpreter; return
+            fi ;;
+          *) ops=$((ops + 1)); [[ "${argv[2]}" == comment && $ops -le 1 ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( stdin )) || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    git)
+      [[ "${argv[1]:-}" == commit ]] || return
+      for ((i = 2; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -F|--file) i=$((i + 1)); [[ "${argv[i]:-}" == "-" ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }; stdin=1 ;;
+          --file=-|-F-) stdin=1 ;;
+          -q|--quiet|-s|--signoff|-a|--all|--allow-empty|--allow-empty-message|-v|--verbose|--no-edit|--amend) ;;
+          *) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( stdin )) || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    br)
+      case "${argv[1]:-}" in create|update) ;; *) return ;; esac
+      for ((i = 2; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -d|--description|--body) [[ "${argv[i+1]:-}" == "-" ]] && stdin=1 ;;
+          -f|--file) [[ "${argv[1]}" == create && "${argv[i+1]:-}" == "-" ]] && stdin=1 ;;
+          --description=-|--body=-) stdin=1 ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( stdin )) || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    jq|yq)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        # In-place flags: --inplace/--in-place, -i, -i=…, and any short-flag cluster holding an i
+        # (corpus D114/D115: `-i` alone did not match `-[A-Za-z]*i*`, which needs a letter before the i).
+        case "${argv[i]}" in --inplace|--in-place|-i*|-[A-Za-z]*i*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;; esac
+      done ;;
+    grep|egrep|fgrep) ;;
+    sed)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -n|--quiet|--silent) has_n=1 ;;
+          -E|-r|--regexp-extended|-s|--separate|-u|--unbuffered|-z|--null-data) ;;
+          -*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+          *) if [[ -z "$script" ]]; then
+               script="$t"; [[ "$script" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_psq || "$script" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_pdq ]] && script="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
+               [[ "$script" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_sedp ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }
+             fi ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      (( has_n )) && [[ -n "$script" ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+    sort)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        t="${argv[i]}"
+        case "$t" in
+          -o) i=$((i + 1)); _bdb_hd_unq_path "${argv[i]:-}" || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; }; _hd_dests[${#_hd_dests[@]}]="$_hd_up" ;;
+          -k|-t) i=$((i + 1)) ;;
+          -k*|-t*) ;;
+          --*) _hd_mcls=interpreter; return ;;
+          -*) [[ "$t" =~ ^-[bdfghiMnRrsuVz]+$ ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;;
+        esac
+      done ;;
+    wc)
+      for ((i = 1; i < ${#argv[@]}; i++)); do
+        case "${argv[i]}" in -*) [[ "${argv[i]}" =~ ^-[lwmL]+$ ]] || { _hd_mcls=interpreter; return; } ;; esac
+      done ;;
+    *) return ;;
+  esac
+  _hd_mcls=nonexec
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_ctx_bad <line> → 0 when a line before (or the header itself) leaves
+# the next text inside a substitution, group, quote, compound command or
+# pipeline: a later heredoc there is interpreter-class.
+_bdb_hd_ctx_bad() {
+  local l="${1:-}" k last
+  case "$l" in *'$('*|*'`'*|*'<('*|*'>('*) return 0 ;; esac
+  _bdb_hd_tokenize "$l" || return 0
+  for ((k = 0; k < ${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}; k++)); do
+    case "${_bdb_hd_tok[k]}" in
+      '('|')'|'{'|'}'|do|done|then|else|elif|if|fi|while|until|for|case|esac|select|function|coproc) return 0 ;;
+    esac
+  done
+  (( ${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]} > 0 )) || return 1
+  last="${_bdb_hd_tok[${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}-1]}"
+  case "$last" in '|'|'|&'|'&&'|'||') return 0 ;; esac
+  return 1
+}
+
+# _bdb_hd_header <line> — parse one header line. Sets _hd_ops (heredoc count,
+# -1 = unreadable), _hd_delim, _hd_quoted, _hd_tabs, _hd_cls, _hd_dests[],
+# _hd_pipe (pipeline id of the heredoc on this line).
+_bdb_hd_header() {
+  local line="${1:-}" k nt t opi=-1 w seg=0 pipe=0
+  local -a tpipe mtoks
+  _hd_ops=0 _hd_delim="" _hd_quoted=0 _hd_tabs=0 _hd_cls=none _hd_pipe=-1
+  _hd_dests=()
+  if ! _bdb_hd_tokenize "$line"; then _hd_ops=-1; return; fi
+  nt=${#_bdb_hd_tok[@]}
+  tpipe=()
+  for ((k = 0; k < nt; k++)); do
+    t="${_bdb_hd_tok[k]}"
+    case "$t" in
+      ';'|';;'|'&'|'&&'|'||'|'('|')') pipe=$((pipe + 1)); tpipe[k]=-1; continue ;;
+      '|'|'|&') tpipe[k]=-1; continue ;;
+    esac
+    tpipe[k]=$pipe
+    if [[ "$t" =~ ^[0-9]*'<<'-?$ ]]; then _hd_ops=$((_hd_ops + 1)); opi=$k; fi
+  done
+  (( _hd_ops == 1 )) || return
+  w="${_bdb_hd_tok[opi+1]:-}"
+  [[ "${_bdb_hd_tok[opi]}" == *'<<-' ]] && _hd_tabs=1
+  if [[ "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_dsq || "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_ddq || "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_dbs ]]; then
+    _hd_delim="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; _hd_quoted=1
+  elif [[ "$w" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_dw ]]; then
+    _hd_delim="$w"

+# fb_parse FILE GATE → one compact JSON object: {file, exists, trailer, verdict,
+# counts, exit_code, sprint_id, ts, approved, hash}. The hash is the run-mode
+# same-issue hash (md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` over verdict-derive's
+# --json output; legacy files hash their findings section).
+fb_parse() {
+  local f="$1" g="$2" rel vj tl pj hash
+  rel="${f#"$root"/}"
+  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then jq -nc --arg f "$rel" '{file: $f, exists: false}'; return 0; fi
+  vj=$(bash "$VERDICT_DERIVE" --file "$f" --gate "$g" --json 2>/dev/null) || true
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$vj" || vj='{"trailer_found":false,"verdict":null,"counts":null,"exit_code":1}'
+  tl=$(grep -E '^<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$' "$f" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) || tl=""
+  pj=$(printf '%s' "$tl" | sed -E 's/^<!-- LOA-VERDICT (.*) -->[[:space:]]*$/\1/')
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$pj" || pj='{}'
+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.trailer_found' <<<"$vj")" == true ]]; then
+    hash=$(printf '%s\n' "$vj" | jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}' | _md5)
+  else
+    hash=$( { grep -A 100 "## Findings\|## Issues\|## Changes Required" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; } | head -50 | _md5)
+  fi
+  jq -nc --arg f "$rel" --argjson v "$vj" --argjson p "$pj" --arg h "$hash" '
+    def sid: if type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$") then . else null end;
+    def tsv: if type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$") then . else null end;
+    {file: $f, exists: true, trailer: ($v.trailer_found == true),
+     verdict: ($v.verdict | if type == "string" then . else null end),
+     counts: ($v.counts // null), exit_code: ($v.exit_code // 1),
+     sprint_id: ($p.sprint_id | sid), ts: ($p.ts | tsv), hash: $h}
+    | .approved = (.exit_code == 0 and .verdict == "APPROVED")'
+}

+# impl_commit SINCE → "sha epoch" of the newest non-merge commit on HEAD since

+impl_commit() {

+    ':(exclude,glob)grimoires/**' ':(exclude,glob).run/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/REPO-MAP.md' \
+    ':(exclude,glob)**/checksums.json' ':(exclude,glob)**/CHANGELOG.md' 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+
+# The ordered rounds of one sprint directory: every -rN file, then the current
+# file unless it is byte-identical to the highest -rN of its gate
+rounds_of() {
+  local dir="$1" g base f n top topn cur
+  for g in review audit; do
+    if [[ "$g" == review ]]; then base=engineer-feedback; else base=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
+    top=""; topn=-1
+    for f in "$dir/$base"-r*.md; do
+      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
+      n=${f##*-r}; n=${n%.md}
+      [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}$ ]] || continue

+    done
+    cur="$dir/$base.md"

+      fb_parse "$cur" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" '. + {gate: $g, round: 999999}'

+def epoch: if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
+def fresh($now; $win): epoch as $t | $t != null and ($now - $t) <= $win and ($t - $now) <= 300;
+def recompute($rounds; $reset):
+  ($rounds
+   | map(select($reset == null or ((.ts // "") > $reset)))
+   | sort_by([(.ts // ""), .round, (if .gate == "review" then 0 else 1 end)])
+   | map(select(.approved | not))) as $nr
+  | reduce $nr[] as $r ({cycle: 0, same: 0, hash: null, np: 0, lc: null};
+      .cycle += 1
+      | (if $r.hash != "none" and $r.hash == .hash then .same += 1 else .same = 1 | .hash = $r.hash end)
+      | ($r.counts | tojson) as $c
+      | (if .lc != null and .lc == $c then .np += 1 else .np = 0 end)
+      | .lc = $c);
+def skeleton($th; $ts):
+  {state: "CLOSED",
+   triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: $th.same, last_hash: null},
+              no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: $th.np},
+              cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: $th.cycles},
+              timeout: {started: $ts, limit_hours: $th.hours}},
+   history: []};
+def merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts):
+  (if type == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
+  | .triggers = (.triggers // {})
+  | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ([(.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0), $rc.cycle] | max)
+  | (if $rc.same > (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0)
+     then .triggers.same_issue.count = $rc.same | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $rc.hash else . end)
+  | (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
+     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
+          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
+  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
+        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
+      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
+        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
+      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
+        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
+      else null end ) as $trip
+  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
+    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
+    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
+def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
+def resolve($f; $now; $win):
+  . as $c
+  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
+  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
+  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
+  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
+      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
+      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new

+  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
+    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
+    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
+    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
+    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
+    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
+'

+cmd_derive() {
+  local ledger="$root/grimoires/loa/ledger.json" a2a="$root/grimoires/loa/a2a" active rows

+              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \

+       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,

+       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
